messages.rollback.preview: Roll back revision {from} to {to}? This may restore older defects. The highest-seen version remains recorded: other intermediate older versions stay blocked. Preferences and user data are kept. The previous package and its license are shown below.
messages.rollback.unavailable: Cannot prepare rollback. The previous package may be missing, damaged, untrusted or incompatible, or the inventory may have changed. Nothing was installed. Refresh the list before trying again.
messages.rollback.done: The previous package version was restored. Preferences, user data and version history were kept. A reload request was sent to the agent if it is running.
messages.package.uncertain: Package state was reread after an uncertain write. The change may already be visible, but durable saving was not confirmed. Do not retry blindly; check the storage.
messages.download.repository: GitHub repository (owner/name, or leave blank to use the accepted source). Do not enter credentials.
messages.download.selection: Selected: {count} packages, {bytes} bytes. Downloading accepts this catalog and keeps its anti-rollback history even if cancelled. Installation requires a separate confirmation.
messages.download.cancelling: Cancelling; waiting for the current operation…
messages.download.cancelled: Download cancelled. No packages were installed. Previously accepted catalog history is kept.
messages.download.ui_only: Interface only — this package does not add an input language.
messages.download.unavailable: Unavailable: incompatible package API or protected English base.
messages.download.failed: Online package operation failed: {code}. Check the catalog again before retrying.
messages.download.install_summary: Verified: {count} packages, {bytes} bytes. Review each license below, then confirm installation. Input selections and interface-language preference are kept. The catalog history has already been accepted.
messages.download.done: Selected packages installed. Input selections and interface-language preference were kept. The reload request was sent to the agent if it is running.
messages.migration.apply_first: Apply or discard unsaved settings before preparing migration. If settings changed outside this window, reopen it and prepare migration again.
messages.migration.summary: Migration: {count} packages, {bytes} bytes. Required existing input data: {required}. Review each package and its license below. Your settings, profile choices, dictionary and exclusions will be kept. Loose interface catalogs will be replaced by verified package catalogs, with English fallback when unavailable. Configuration mode is saved last with an exact backup. If saving fails, prepared package files may remain unused.
messages.migration.done: Managed package mode saved. Existing settings and user data were kept. The reload request was sent to the agent if it is running.
messages.remove.done: Package removed from the active inventory. Preferences and user data were kept. Cached files remain. The reload request was sent to the agent if it is running.
messages.import.legacy: Local import requires managed package mode. Existing installations need an explicit migration first.
messages.import.done: Package installed. Input participation and interface language were not changed. The reload request was sent to the agent if it is running.
messages.packs.profile_default: Use the sole declared profile; otherwise unavailable
messages.general.apply_hint: Changes take effect after you select Apply.
messages.general.title: General settings
messages.general.description: Right-click the tray icon for the menu; left-click for settings. Blue: automatic conversion is on. Gray: it is off.
messages.general.physical_fallback: Physical replacement when safe UIA access is unavailable
messages.general.recheck_erased: Recheck the first word after it has been fully erased
messages.general.single_letter_words: Automatically convert single-letter words (for example z → я)
messages.general.offer_exclusion: Offer a word exclusion after undo
messages.general.offer_dictionary: Offer to add a word after forced conversion
messages.hotkey.help:
Correct: type a word without a trailing space, then press the shortcut.
Undo: press it immediately after automatic conversion.
With Ctrl / Alt / Shift / Win, the action runs after the keys are released.
messages.rules.description: When a rule is enabled, the current word is not corrected after that action.
messages.rules.no_enter_tab: Do not convert on Tab / Enter (required safety rule in this version)
messages.languages.description: At least two input languages must remain enabled for automatic conversion.
messages.languages.interface_only_note: A downloaded language that does not appear here was published as interface only: it translates the app but has no input rules, so it cannot be used for conversion.
messages.languages.active_hint: Checked languages are used for automatic and manual conversion. Keep at least two checked.
messages.languages.add_hint: Open the catalog window to download more language packs. After installing, the language appears in the list above and you can check it.
messages.languages.advanced_hint: Import a local package file, migrate a legacy installation, remove a package, or roll back to a previous version.
messages.add_language.title: Add language
messages.add_language.hint: Check the languages to download, then install them. Installing does not change which languages are active.
messages.packs.notice: Selection is independent of the interface language. Automatic conversion needs two compatible profiles available in Windows. Current adapters handle ordinary physical keys only; AltGr, dead keys and IME composition are not fully supported. This list does not verify live Windows availability.
messages.packs.missing: Package data is missing; the saved selection is retained.
messages.error.pack_selection: The input-package selection is invalid or exceeds the supported limit.
messages.languages.japanese_pending: Japanese — ja-JP (requires a safe IME adapter)
messages.dictionary.description: One entry per line: en-US: firefox, ru-RU: слово, or et-EE: tere.
messages.word_exclusions.description: These words will never be corrected automatically.
messages.process_exclusions.description: Built-in protection for system windows and password managers always remains enabled.
messages.backends.description: Rules match an exact executable name or path; '*' sets the fallback route. These rules cannot disable privacy checks.
messages.diagnostics.description: The local log records stages, counters, PIDs, language IDs and lengths, not typed text, URLs or clipboard contents.
messages.about.description: AutoKeyboardLayot is a local keyboard layout correction agent.
messages.about.current_languages: Automatic input languages: EN / RU / ET
messages.about.japanese_pending: The Japanese pack is registered; IME conversion is not enabled yet.

messages.hotkey.cancelled: Recording cancelled; the previous shortcut has been kept.
messages.hotkey.reset_hint: Pause/Break selected without modifiers. Select Apply.
messages.settings.saved_notified: Settings saved. The update was sent to the agent.
messages.settings.saved_agent_unavailable: Settings saved; the agent is currently unavailable.
messages.error.open_log: Could not open the diagnostic log.
messages.hotkey.release_retry: Release the keys, then select Record a shortcut again.
messages.hotkey.start_failed: Could not start recording. You can select Reset to Pause/Break.
messages.hotkey.release_repeat: Release the keys and try recording again.
messages.hotkey.record_hint: Press Pause/Break, an F-key, or a shortcut with Ctrl / Alt / Shift / Win. Esc cancels.
messages.hotkey.modifier_required: Hold Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win for a letter or digit. Pause/Break and F1–F24 are also supported.
messages.recovery.repeat_warning: Some retained input may already have reached the application. Repeating it may duplicate text or shortcuts. Prepare recovery anyway?
messages.recovery.discard_warning: Delete the retained keystrokes from memory? They cannot be recovered afterwards.
messages.recovery.discarded_body: The keystrokes were removed from memory at your request and can no longer be recovered.
messages.dictionary.added: Word added to the user dictionary.
messages.conversion.forced_body: Use the tray menu to add the corrected word to the user dictionary.
messages.conversion.undone_body: Use the tray menu to exclude the last undone word from conversion.
messages.lifecycle.close_busy: The agent is busy or has retained keystrokes. Finish the current operation, recover or explicitly delete retained input if present, then try closing again.
messages.lifecycle.settings_unsaved: Settings contain unsaved or invalid changes. Save them before closing, or choose Cancel to explicitly discard them.
messages.lifecycle.settings_busy: Finish the current package operation or file selection before closing settings.
messages.recovery.retained_body: Automatic conversion is paused. The menu offers recovery of retained keystrokes. Nothing was written to a file or the clipboard.
messages.menu.dictionary_add: Add the last corrected word to the dictionary
messages.menu.exclude_word: Do not correct the last undone word
messages.hotkey.selected: Selected {hotkey}. Release the keys, then select Apply.
messages.recovery.ready_body: Retained keyboard events: {count}. Return to the original field, position the caret, and press {hotkey}.
messages.error.add_word: Could not add the word to {destination}: {error}
messages.conversion.paused_body: The operation was not confirmed ({reason}). Check the text. See diagnostics for details; use the right-click menu to re-enable automatic conversion.
messages.ui_language.label: Interface language
messages.import.failure.store: The managed package store cannot be opened. Check that the profile directory is available and the configuration still uses managed packages.
messages.import.failure.snapshot: The current package inventory cannot be read. Another operation may be using it; retry after it finishes.
messages.import.failure.prepare: The package could not be prepared or verified. Nothing was installed.
messages.import.failure.file: The selected file is not a valid language package.
messages.import.failure.migration: The settings changed outside this window, so the migration was aborted. Reopen the settings and try again.
messages.import.failure.catalog: The package catalog is no longer available or the selection is invalid. Check the catalog again.
messages.import.failure.install: Installing the prepared package failed. Nothing was changed.
messages.import.failure.thread: The package operation could not be started. Try again.
messages.import.failed: Package operation failed. No automatic retry will be made; inspect the current package state before retrying.
